label: Architecture decision: converge on per-surface dual-version bridges (dualPlugin for plugins; symlinked single trees plus the guarded v1-shape opencode.json for commands/agents/config; the version resolver plus dynamic doctor battery for dispatch; the provision list for worktrees; native dual for sk-vision) with ONE shared enforcement layer: every surface gets a disk-derived inventory (readdir, git ls-files, diff -rq) asserted equal to expectations in blocking CI, with an explicit exceptions manifest checked both ways. sk-vision stays native-dual as the designed Class B exception (hook key chat.message outside MAPPED_HOOKS; v2-native setup) with a standing obligation to re-verify V2PluginContext against @opencode/plugin at each OpenCode 2 bump. Enforcement belongs in tests+CI, not the doctor battery, because the drifted literals all live in test suites and prose docs.
